title: Cloud data platform
subtitle: Ingest, land in the lake, transform, serve and read: one copy of the data, every stage at its own height.
note: SYNTHETIC illustration of a generic cloud data platform. Generic names, no vendors or logos; not a reference architecture or a measured system.

layers.label: Data lake
layers.description: Object storage with open table formats: raw, cleaned and curated zones.

layers.label: Ingest
layers.description: Sources outside the platform and the jobs that bring their data in, in batches or as events.

layers.label: Transform
layers.description: Spark jobs clean and join; quality checks gate every promotion to the curated zone.

layers.label: Serve
layers.description: A curated warehouse, a metrics layer and a data API answer every consumer.

layers.label: BI & apps
layers.description: Reports, live dashboards and a partner portal.

domains.label: Consumers
domains.description: Metrics, API, BI and the people who read them.

domains.label: Governance
domains.description: Catalog, lineage and access control across every stage.

nodes.label: Data lake
nodes.description: Raw, cleaned and curated zones as open columnar files in object storage.

nodes.label: SaaS CRM
nodes.description: Third-party CRM exposing an export API.

nodes.label: Orders database
nodes.description: Operational SQL database; read through change data capture.

nodes.label: Web & app events
nodes.description: Click and usage events from web and mobile clients.

nodes.label: Batch ingest
nodes.description: Scheduled copy of CRM exports and database changes into the raw zone.

nodes.label: Event ingest
nodes.description: Event stream that buffers clicks and writes micro-batches to the raw zone.

nodes.label: Spark transforms
nodes.description: Cleans, deduplicates and joins raw tables into the cleaned and curated zones.

nodes.label: Quality checks
nodes.description: Row counts, schema and freshness checks; a failed check stops the promotion.

nodes.label: Catalog & lineage
nodes.description: Every table, its owner, schema history and lineage.

nodes.label: Curated warehouse
nodes.description: Star schemas over the curated zone for SQL consumers.

nodes.label: Metrics layer
nodes.description: Shared measure definitions (revenue, active users) used by every report.

nodes.label: Data API
nodes.description: Read-only API over curated tables for applications.

nodes.label: Access control
nodes.description: Single sign-on, roles and column masking enforced at the warehouse and the API.

nodes.label: Executive BI
nodes.description: Revenue and growth reports on the metrics layer.

nodes.label: Partner portal
nodes.description: Partner-facing app that reads its own data through the API.

annotations.text: Nothing reaches the curated zone without passing its checks.
Engines read the one lake copy; no per-tool duplicates.
